other_conditions: Must hold an M.Sc. or equivalent degree with at least 55% marks
Must have qualified JRF‑NET (CSIR/UGC) & LS‑NET in the Joint CSIR‑UGC Test for Junior Research Fellowship and be eligible for lectureship (NET)
Must be a permanent resident of Haryana
Must be interested in full‑time research leading to a Ph.D. in the relevant science disciplines
Applicants receiving a fellowship or financial assistance from any other source are not eligible
Upper age limit is 28 years, with a relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates belonging to SC, ST, Women, Physically Handicapped, and OBC categories
benefits_summary: Provides a stipend of up to ₹31,000 per month for JRF (or ₹18,000 for LS‑NET) plus an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000, with a tenure of up to five years.
